title.narrative: Renew LLC - Startup preparation investment training SPRINT

description.narrative:
Renew Capital’s SPRINT program aims to catalyse entrepreneurial ecosystems of Mozambique, Malawi and Ghana. Their approach Invest + Impact mobilizes capital into Africa’s missing middle and help companies through the critical stages of growth. SPRINT Program will seek to channel NOK 120 million of private and commercial capital into innovative startups and growth-oriented SMEs, in addition to providing technical assistance. Target companies will be offering innovative, scalable and tech-enabled solutions to bolster the blue economy, combat marine litter and facilitate climate change adaptation. Programme impact – Vibrant, more climate resilient and gender-responsive startup and SME ecosystems in Mozambique, Malawi and Ghana
Programme outcome: 1 - Enhanced incubation and scaling of innovative private sector solutions and business models that results in a more investable pipeline of deals 2 - Increased provision of capital into and management of climate-smart and gender-responsive companies 3 - Improved enabling environment and startup and investment ecosystems for climate-smart and gender-responsive startups and SMEs
